mapper.select: SELECT id AS userId, name FROM user WHERE id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM( CASE WHEN COALESCE(changed_category, category) = 'SALARY' THEN amount ELSE 0 END ) > 0 THEN SUM( CASE WHEN COALESCE(changed_category, category) = 'SALARY' THEN amount ELSE 0 END ) ELSE COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) END AS income_base FROM service_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'INCOME' AND YEAR(record_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(record_date) = #{month}
SELECT CASE WHEN groom_id = #{userId} THEN bride_id ELSE groom_id END AS partner_id FROM couple WHERE (groom_id = #{userId} OR bride_id = #{userId}) AND status = 'CONNECTED' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense_feedback ( writer_id, receiver_id, year, month, content ) VALUES ( #{writerUserId}, #{receiverUserId}, #{year}, #{month}, #{content} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), receiver_id = VALUES(receiver_id), content = VALUES(content)
mapper.select: SELECT ef.id AS feedbackId, ef.writer_id AS writerUserId, writer.name AS writerName, ef.receiver_id AS receiverUserId, receiver.name AS receiverName, ef.year AS year, ef.month AS month, ef.content AS content FROM expense_feedback ef INNER JOIN user writer ON writer.id = ef.writer_id INNER JOIN user receiver ON receiver.id = ef.receiver_id WHERE ef.id = #{feedbackId}

SELECT id AS mission_id, category AS category_code, title, expected_saving AS expected_saving_amount, status, CASE WHEN status = '도전하기' AND created_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND created_at < DATE_ADD( DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) THEN true ELSE false END AS is_selectable FROM saving_missions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(created_at) = #{year} AND MONTH(created_at) = #{month} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id FROM user WHERE is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id

SELECT COALESCE(changed_category, category) AS category_code, SUM(amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(id) AS tx_count FROM service_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND record_date >= #{startDate} AND record_date < #{endDate} GROUP BY COALESCE(changed_category, category) ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN category_name IN ('식료품·비주류음료', '음식·숙박') THEN 'FOOD' WHEN category_name IN ('주거·수도·광열', '가정용품·가사서비스', '보건', '교통', '통신') THEN 'LIVING' WHEN category_name = '의류·신발' THEN 'SHOPPING' WHEN category_name = '오락·문화' THEN 'CULTURE' WHEN category_name IN ('주류·담배', '교육', '기타상품·서비스') THEN 'ETC' END AS categoryCode, SUM(average_amount) AS averageAmount FROM expense_statistics WHERE age_group = 'ALL' AND household_type = 'SINGLE' AND year = ( SELECT MAX(year) FROM expense_statistics WHERE age_group = 'ALL' AND household_type = 'SINGLE' AND year <= #{analysisYear} ) AND category_name IN ( '식료품·비주류음료', '음식·숙박', '주거·수도·광열', '가정용품·가사서비스', '보건', '교통', '통신', '의류·신발', '오락·문화', '주류·담배', '교육', '기타상품·서비스' ) GROUP BY categoryCode ORDER BY FIELD(categoryCode, 'FOOD', 'LIVING', 'SHOPPING', 'CULTURE', 'ETC')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saving_missions ( user_id, category, title, expected_saving, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryCode}, #{title}, #{expectedSavingAmount}, #{status}, #{createdAt} )
